name: openvscode-server
description: Openvscode-server(https://github.com/gitpod-io/openvscode-server) provides a version of VS Code that runs a server on a remote machine and allows access through a modern web browser.

variables.name: CONNECTION_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional security token for accessing the Web UI (ie. `supersecrettoken`).

variables.name: CONNECTION_SECRET
variables.description: Optional path to a file inside the container that contains the security token for accessing the Web UI (ie. `/path/to/file`). Overrides `CONNECTION_TOKEN`.

variables.name: SUDO_PASSWORD
variables.description: If this optional variable is set, user will have sudo access in the openvscode-server terminal with the specified password.

variables.name: SUDO_PASSWORD_HASH
variables.description: Optionally set sudo password via hash (takes priority over `SUDO_PASSWORD` var). Format is `$type$salt$hashed`.
